title: oldenlandia rupestris
intro: Oldenlandia rupestris, commonly known as rocky oldenlandia, is a plant species that belongs to the family Rubiaceae. It is a traditional medicinal plant used in various cultures for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties that help in reducing fever and alleviating symptoms of respiratory infections. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, improve immune function, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Oldenlandia rupestris include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
